text:
Predicates:
Eastern(x) ::: x is an Eastern wild turkey.
Osceola(x) ::: x is an Osceola wild turkey.
Gould(x) ::: x is a Gould’s wild turkey.
Merriam(x) ::: x is Merriam’s wild turkey.
RioGrande(x) ::: x is Rio Grande wild turkey.
Ocellated(x) ::: x is Ocellated wild turkey.
Tom ::: Tom is a specific individual.
WildTurkey(x) ::: x is a wild turkey.

Premises:
¬Eastern(tom) ::: Tom is not an Eastern wild turkey.
¬Osceola(tom) ::: Tom is not an Osceola wild turkey.
¬Gould(tom) ∨ ¬Merriam(tom) ∨ ¬RioGrande(tom) ::: Tom is not a Gould’s, Merriam’s, or Rio Grande wild turkey.
WildTurkey(tom) ::: Tom is a wild turkey.

Conclusion:
Eastern(tom) ::: Tom is an Eastern wild turkey.
